persistence: append exactly these resources to bootstrap and existing configured allowlists; preserve every prior entry and grant
preconditions: revalidate stopped VM identity, resource preset, SSH path and private application endpoint
verify deployed image/client/server versions without upgrade
verify both existing principals are non-admin and preserve their passwords
resolve the exact experiment ID by name after bounded create-if-absent
inspect current grants; abort on conflicting broader permissions instead of revoke/replace
use compatible 3.13+ RBAC calls; record before/after grants
verification: one retained metadata-only smoke run, at most 1 MiB inert artifact roundtrip
writer creates/reads run and artifact; exporter reads and is denied write
confirm no change to existing experiment/model grants or default permissions
stop VM when done; independently verify STOPPED and retain receipts
out_of_scope: new cloud IAM grants or public network rules
server upgrade or live database restore
trained model versions, aliases or production promotion
GPU training, final-test access, G8 rerun
deletion of probes, resources or prior evidence
failure_policy: stop and preserve partial state; no automatic revoke, deletion or replacement
